canonical_signature_contract.independent_accepted_shape: JSON array of length exactly 5 in component_order
canonical_signature_contract.primary_accepted_shape: JSON object whose key set equals component_order exactly
canonical_signature_contract.scalar_rule: Each scalar component must have JSON integer type, not boolean, and be >= 0.
canonical_signature_contract.field_arities_rule: representation_field_arities must be a JSON array of JSON integers, not booleans, each >= 0, already sorted nondecreasing.

global_requirements: primary and independent read_set attest frozen_48_bytes=false and candidate_58_bytes=false
adjudication_gate.status_rule: PASS iff every global requirement and every per-fixture equality holds; otherwise FAIL with explicit failure reasons.

forbidden_inputs: any fixture source file outside the archived output JSON
original expected predictions or mutation metadata

negative_self_tests_required: one changed scalar component compares unequal
one changed field arity compares unequal
mapping with missing key is rejected
mapping with extra key is rejected
sequence with length other than five is rejected
boolean in integer position is rejected

8_FREEZE OUTPUT REGARDLESS OF PASS_OR_FAIL_BEFORE ANY FURTHER CHANGE
first_complete_rule: The first complete checker-only adjudication output is immutable and must be archived regardless of PASS or FAIL before any adjudicator/protocol/gate change.
